# Paths NOT copied into the GitHub Pages artifact (_site) by scripts/pages-build.mjs.
# Anchored at the repo root. One entry per line. '#' starts a comment.
#   dir/        a directory and everything under it
#   path/file   one exact file
#   * and **    glob: '*' = within one path segment, '**' = across segments
#
# Why this exists: keepitil.com is served by GitHub Pages with .nojekyll, so every tracked
# file is public. An entry below REMOVES those URLs from the live site. Each entry must be
# proven unreferenced by anything that is deployed (scripts/pages-closure-check.mjs enforces
# this on every build: a deployed html/css/manifest/js/json/xml file that points at an
# excluded file fails the build).
#
# Never exclude: CNAME, .nojekyll, 404.html, index.html, .well-known/ (apple-app-site-association),
# games/, app/, assets/ except the entries below.

# Version control and CI (the upload action drops .git/.github too; listed for clarity).
.git/
.github/
.gitignore
node_modules/

# Test suites, docs, seed SQL and package manifests: not site content.
tests/
docs/
db/
package.json
package-lock.json

# Full-size PNG originals; every page uses the -400/-600/-900/-1024 .webp and .avif siblings.
assets/sponsors/originals/

# Flutter debug symbol maps (*.js.symbols). The engine never fetches them; nothing mentions them.
app/tuitea/app/canvaskit/**/*.js.symbols

# Build tooling for this very workflow, and its unit test (they name excluded files in strings).
scripts/
assets/js/pages-closure.test.mjs
